item.no_lewd_otherworld.ball_gag.desc: Wear in the face trinket slot. Prevents normal speech and blocks mouth-related animations.
Wear in the face trinket slot. Unlocked by default; bind and toggle it with a key.
item.no_lewd_otherworld.ring_gag.desc: Wear in the face trinket slot. Prevents normal speech but does not block mouth-related animations.
Wear in the face trinket slot. Prevents normal speech but does not block mouth-related animations; unlocked by default, bind and toggle it with a key.
item.no_lewd_otherworld.collar.desc: Wear in the necklace trinket slot.
message.no_lewd_otherworld.equip_failed: Could not equip: the matching trinket slot may already be occupied.
item.no_lewd_otherworld.locked_collar.de: Wear in the necklace trinket slot. Unlocked by default; bind and toggle it with a key.
item.no_lewd_otherworld.locked_handcuffs: Wear in the glove trinket slot. When locked, prevents attacking, using items or blocks, breaking blocks, changing equipment/trinkets, and using commands. Movement, looking, chat, inventory organization, and dropping items remain allowed; normal behavior returns when unlocked.
item.no_lewd_otherworld.key.desc: Use on yourself or another player to bind an unbound padlocked trinket; use it again to toggle the bound trinket's lock.

message.no_lewd_otherworld.key_no_target: The target has no unbound padlocked trinket or trinket bound to this key.
message.no_lewd_otherworld.key_no_trinke: Could not read the player's trinket inventory.
message.no_lewd_otherworld.key_error: The key action failed. See the local game log at logs/latest.log.
message.no_lewd_otherworld.master_key_un: The master key removed the binding and unlocked the trinket.
item.no_lewd_otherworld.master_key.desc: Administrator tool: removes a padlocked trinket's binding and unlocks it.
item.no_lewd_otherworld.shock_controller: First use binds a player and the collar they are wearing; later uses deal 1 damage. If they go offline or remove/change the collar, the next use unbinds the controller.
message.no_lewd_otherworld.controller_no: The target is not wearing a collar or padlocked collar.
message.no_lewd_otherworld.controller_co: The padlocked collar is still locked. Unlock it first or hold its matching key to bind.
message.no_lewd_otherworld.controller_bo: The shock controller is bound to %1$s (collar ID: %2$s).
message.no_lewd_otherworld.controller_un: The target is offline or removed/changed the collar; the shock controller is now unbound.
